program: Node & Norm Catholic Institutional AI Risk and Control Evidence Pilot
applies_to: All NEW confirmatory model/tool/agent invocations and iterative calls made through the prospective pilot runner; original run files retain their historical capture scopes.
exclusion: Historical PQA, CIR-001, source-review, bibliography and literature-screening records are neither overwritten nor retroactively certified.
required_visible_capture: Original caller-supplied prompt as a verbatim UTF-8 string, if a model/agent is invoked
Full caller-visible tool arguments (JSON), prior to the invocation
Full visible response object and verbatim text, where returned and accessible
A separate start and success/error/incomplete event for EACH attempt, including failures and retries
UTC client-side before-call and after-call event timestamps; never substitute them for provider latency
Run ID, case ID, unique call ID, attempt count, tool identity, provider identity and declared data status
Exact model snapshot and generation parameters when caller-visible; otherwise null and an explicit reason
Recorded missing transport bytes, hidden model instructions, hidden retrieval or provider internals; never reconstruct these
SHA-256 of exact prompt, visible JSON payload and returned text; a cross-event hash chain
Plan file hash, frozen Git commit, owner/reviewer/rights/ethics gates, execution budget and source provenance
AI-use and human decision disclosures, including missing attestations and post-outcome exposure

states.start: Logged and fsynced before external invoke; no response assumed.
states.success: Returned visible payload and exact response text recorded, not a correctness judgment.
states.error: The attempted invocation raised an error. Error type retained; raw exception message may be withheld for safety with explicit omission.
states.incomplete_capture: Visible returned data lacks a verbatim model answer, is not JSON-serializable, or cannot be safely published; blocks promotion.
states.open_request: Call began but no visible terminal record exists; blocks promotion.
states.not_exposed: Provider data absent from the caller's interface; never inferred.

protection.classification: Only public/rights-cleared or synthetic records are allowed in this public repository.
protection.known_secret_key_guard: A basic key-name scan rejects common credential fields; this is NOT a general private-data detector.
protection.unexpected_sensitive_result: Public trace is marked incomplete and only a withheld marker is published. Any verbatim sensitive original requires separate, approved private custody.
protection.publication: Git commits supply immutable snapshot identifiers; SHA chains detect edits relative to prior checkpoints but do not authenticate a maliciously regenerated chain.
protection.consent: Qualified reviewer consent and applicable institutional research ethics must be assessed before involving identifiable people.

pending_run_manifest.immutable_status: PROPOSAL ONLY — values intentionally unapproved, preflight must fail

existing_custody.scope: Six exact submitted visible prompts, complete visible answer+reference objects and client-side call timestamps preserved; assistant-serialized, not HTTP raw bytes.
Authored cases, original deterministic engine, first execution receipts and replay outputs are preserved; no live model calls.
Preliminary 19-claim annotations and sources; no verbatim trace for every internal assistant drafting operation.
Seven-paper registry and notebook outputs retained; complete verbatim internal research prompt history is unavailable.

fake_execution: Tests use Python offline fixtures and fake callable responses only. No provider, MCP or real institutional data are called.
